typography.strategy: The 'Cinematic Brutalist' - combining massive punchy sans, editorial serif for tension, and technical mono for video metadata.

headings_kinetic.usage: Massive kinetic text moments, hero reveal, marquee

headings_editorial.usage: Chapter titles, manifesto numbers, quotes, creating contrast

body_technical.usage: Timecodes, project roles, category tags, navigation links

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[8vw] tracking-tighter leading-[0.85] uppercase

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro & Luxury Hybrid (Deep Cinematic)
rules: NO GRADIENTS on backgrounds. Use noise textures instead.
Accent color (Signal Red #FF2A00) is reserved STRICTLY for the 'recording' dot, kinetic hover states, and the primary submit button.
Use #050505 for the absolute base. #0A0A0A for alternating sections.

surfaces.navigation: Crystal Glass: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10
surfaces.portfolio_cards: Grid Borders: border border-white/10 bg-transparent hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors
surfaces.contact_input: Retro-Futurism: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 focus:border-white rounded-none

textures: Mandatory SVG noise overlay across the entire site (fixed, pointer-events-none, opacity 3-5%)
visual_enhancers.shapes: Sharp edges (rounded-none) everywhere except for specific 'recording' dots.

component_name: Shadcn UI Form, Input, Textarea, Button (Heavily customized, stripped of default borders/radius)

grids.portfolio: The 'Tetris' Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-px bg-white/10 (border-collapse look). Spans: Hero project col-span-12 md:col-span-8, Secondary col-span-12 md:col-span-4.

layouts.hero: 100vh flex flex-col justify-center px-4 md:px-12 relative overflow-hidden. Kinetic text dominates the center. Inline muted background video/image masked by text.
layouts.portfolio_section: Dense, edge-to-edge bento layout. No standard margins between cards, just 1px borders.
layouts.manifesto_chapters: Staggered list layout. Massive serif numbers on the left, narrow text column on the right.
layouts.contact: Two-column grid (md:grid-cols-2). Left: Huge typography 'LET'S TALK' + Email. Right: Minimalist form.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal using Framer Motion (initial Y: 100%, animate to 0% with ease-[0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] over 1s, staggered).
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on portfolio images using Framer Motion useScroll.
motion.hover_states: Portfolio items: scale image 1.05x, dim background to 50%, reveal play button icon in center.
motion.marquee: Slow, smooth drift. font-serif text-3xl uppercase tracking-widest text-white/50.

accessibility.contrast: Text must maintain 4.5:1 ratio. Ghost grey (#A3A3A3) on #050505 passes (9.1:1).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all Framer animations.

media.images: Use overlay bg-black/40 on portfolio thumbnails to ensure text readability.
media.videos: Inline HTML5 <video> with autoPlay muted loop playsInline for the hero and hover states of portfolio items.

3d_libraries.strategy: Framer Motion 3D transitions for portfolio card hovers (slight tilt) to keep performance high. No heavy Canvas/R3F needed as video content is the primary heavy asset.

hero_b_roll_1.description: Professional cameraman warmly lit, used for hero background or main manifesto image.

portfolio_thumbnail_2.description: Video editor dual monitors color grading

about_portrait.description: Close up profile man dramatic lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'lenis' (@studio-freight/lenis) for momentum scrolling and initialize it globally in a useEffect.
Install 'framer-motion' for the line-by-line kinetic typography.
Implement the kinetic text reveal: Split the heading into words/lines, wrap each in overflow-hidden, and animate the Y translation of the inner span.
Use pure raw HTML/Tailwind for the portfolio bento grid to achieve the 1px border-collapse aesthetic without Shadcn card constraints.
Shadcn forms must be heavily modified to remove rounded corners, soft shadows, and backgrounds. Make inputs look like stark 1px bottom-bordered lines (Retro-futurism).

Include a
to add cinematic grain.
Add 'data-testid' to all key elements (nav links, form inputs, submit button, portfolio cards).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
